recipes.label: Slightly Weary
recipes.startdescription: The attack poses no real threat, yet it still manages to trouble me somewhat—
recipes.description: It will consume a portion of my surplus stamina.

recipes.label: Slightly Weary
recipes.startdescription: The attack poses no real threat, yet it still manages to trouble me somewhat—
recipes.description: It will temporarily disrupt a portion of my mind.

recipes.label: Defenseless!
recipes.startdescription: I failed to muster enough strength to resist the enemy, and now I will pay the price—

recipes.label: A setback!
recipes.description: As long as I still retain even a sliver of spare strength, I shall not suffer overly grave injury — but this portion of power will require some time to recover.

recipes.label: I'm Hurt!
recipes.description: It didn't have to be this way![If the attack fails to absorb Health, it will create a Wound. Receiving three Wounds of any kind will result in immediate death.]

recipes.label: Defenseless!
recipes.startdescription: I failed to muster enough strength to resist the enemy, and now I will pay the price—

recipes.label: A Heavy Blow!
recipes.description: As long as I still retain even a sliver of spare strength, wounds of this kind will not prove fatal—but that portion of power cannot be restored without external aid.

recipes.label: Grievously Wounded!
recipes.description: Awakened Torment, Greater Than Before—[Three simultaneous Wounds of any kind will result in instant death, and such Wounds cannot heal on their own.]

recipes.label: Defenseless!
recipes.startdescription: I have failed to summon the strength necessary to face the foe; now my mind lies exposed to the threat—

recipes.label: Mind Wounded!
recipes.startdescription:
My reason is thrown into chaos, my passion dwindles and wanes—

[Be warned: if both reason and passion are injured, mental strikes will directly kill you.]

recipes.label: In Utter Despair
recipes.startdescription: Darkness swallows all. My consciousness helplessly sinks.

recipes.label: Defenseless!
recipes.startdescription: I have failed to summon the strength necessary to face the foe; now my mind lies exposed to a deadly threat—

recipes.label: Burden of the Mind
recipes.startdescription:
My reason lies shattered into gleaming fragments, my passion withers like leaves in the wind—

[This damaged Ability card cannot recover on its own. Beware: if both Reason and Passion are already wounded, a mental strike will kill you outright.]

recipes.label: A Horrifying Power
recipes.startdescription: An irresistible force crushes my very existence—

recipes.label: No Longer Sustained
recipes.startdescription:
—Each strike pushes me closer to the brink of destruction!

[This damaged Ability card cannot recover on its own; beware: taking a final blow with no usable Abilities left will cause instant death.]

recipes.label: Jaws of the Wolf
recipes.startdescription: The flames of annihilation consumed my flesh and soul; the Wolf's bite ran deep, and it was excruciating—

recipes.label: Annihilation
recipes.startdescription: For one devoured by the Wolf, this may be the most merciful of ends.

recipes.label: A Reckoning
recipes.startdescription: The Madrugad will take her due in the end.

recipes.label: Frenzy
recipes.startdescription: Neither alive nor dead. I am forever lost.

recipes.label: Red Tide
recipes.startdescription: A sweet red tide devoured me.
